name: maisondecloth +cafe (メゾンドクロスカフェ)
reasoning: Identity and openness survive — the Tabelog listing (広島市安佐北区可部南2-14-52) confirms the shop is open and independently calls it 「グルテンフリーのカフェ」, two independent Hiroshima outlets (modokimaru, bm-peekaboo) describe a menu of 米粉ワッフル / 米粉パン / 麹デリランチ with no wheat items, and it is not on the japan-glutenfree.com closed-shop register. The LABEL does not survive. This shop sells 米粉パン, and the confirmed Hiroshima regional trap is that local rice-flour bakeries commonly blend in 小麦グルテン (vital wheat gluten) for structure — the shop has documented nothing to rule that out, and 'グルテンフリー' branding on Instagram is unverified marketing. Decisively, maisondecloth is ABSENT from the national japan-glutenfree.com register, whose admission criterion is facility-level (「工房・店内に小麦粉を一切持ち込まず、すべての商品がグルテンフリー」) and which does list two other Hiroshima rice-flour bakeries — a shop like this would obviously qualify if it met the bar, so the absence is itself evidence. With no allergen statement, no celiac-grade review anywhere, and unverified 自家製麹調味料 on the deli lunch, the two supporting sources are hobbyist blogs echoing the shop's own branding rather than independent verification of handling.
red_flags: 米粉パン + confirmed Hiroshima regional trap: local rice-flour bakeries commonly add 小麦グルテン (vital wheat gluten, ~20%) — not ruled out here, and 'no 小麦粉' would not exclude it

The ekie広島駅店 was an explicitly 期間限定 (limited-run) pop-up, 2025-04-25 through 2025-09-30, per the shop's own note post and the ekie event listing, and Tabelog now marks 【閉店】田万里家 ekie広島駅店 as permanently closed. The company's own site lists only the Takehara honten (広島県竹原市田万里町1336-4) as a current location — roughly 50 km east of Hiroshima Station, a different destination entirely. name: Komeko Udon Undo (米粉うどん製麺所 undo／あんど)
reasoning: This is a wheat-inherent cuisine (udon) at a positive tier, so I presumed it wrong and went hunting for the wheat: I found instead that the noodles are documented 100% rice flour with 「小麦粉不使用」, that the shop states 「出汁やタレなどもすべてグルテンフリー」 (broth AND tare — the usual trap), and, critically, that the sister wheat okonomiyaki shop 広島お好み焼き undo sits in a SEPARATE building across the street rather than sharing a kitchen. Corroboration is genuinely independent and includes celiac-grade evidence: FindMeGlutenFree lists undo factory as a dedicated gluten-free restaurant with celiac reviewers calling it the 'best gf udon i've ever had', alongside a Hiroshima Home TV news segment and a separate on-site interview by bm-peekaboo. I found no glutening report, no closure notice, and no wheat item on the menu. Remaining gaps: no written allergen protocol, and shared boiling water within the shop is undocumented.
red_flags: VITAL WHEAT GLUTEN LOOPHOLE: 「小麦粉不使用」 (no wheat FLOUR) does not exclude 小麦グルテン/小麦たんぱく, which Hiroshima rice-flour producers commonly add for chew — and rice-flour udon is exactly where that additive is used. Partly offset by the shop's separate blanket 「すべてグルテンフリー」 claim and by celiac reviewers eating there without incident, but ask about 小麦グルテン by name at the counter
No written allergen/cross-contact protocol published by the shop

name: Cafe Fuwafuwa (Cafe ふわふわ)
reasoning: DISPROVED. The record's central claim — 'no wheat flour and no wheat pasta on the premises (the seed's shared pasta menu does not exist)' — is false. The cafe's own menu page carries a full pasta section (ツナときのこの和風パスタ ¥1,280, 沖縄風カルボナーラ ¥1,380, 野菜たっぷりトマトソースパスタ ¥1,280) with the note that the standard pasta uses wheat and butter and that gluten-free rice pasta is an opt-in substitution; Vegewel independently classifies the venue as 'Pasta / Pancake' cuisine with a 'Gluten-Free Menu' (a GF subset), not a wheat-free kitchen. So this is a shared kitchen boiling wheat pasta — shared water, colanders and utensils are a textbook cross-contact vector — on top of the already-flagged wheat teriyaki/soy sauces on the savory pancakes. The pancakes really are 米粉100% and I found no glutening report, but a mixed kitchen with no allergen protocol and no celiac-grade review cannot hold 'high'.
